title: Perpetual chase of an unprotected horse; repeated position is not the setup position
rationale: The rook renews the attack on the unprotected black horse each move (a3 attacks a5, c3 attacks c6) while the horse flees between a5 and c6, attacking nothing relevant. The repeated position first arises after White's first move, so the fixture also pins that repetition counting is position-based, not tied to the setup FEN. The chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence.
